newsitem.title: SYRIA: Radical leader plans to return to West Bank.
newsitem.headline: Radical leader plans to return to West Bank.

text.p: Radical Palestinian leader Nayef Hawatmeh is preparing to return to the West Bank but is still waiting for Israeli approval, his spokesman said on Thursday.

A spokemsan for Hawatmeh's Democratic Front for the Liberation of Palestine (DFLP) said Israel was refusing to give guarantees to the European Union, China and Russia that would ensure Hawatmeh's safety.
"The Israeli occupation authorities are also still refusing to allow Hawatmeh's bodyguards, a team of secretaries and adminstration to return with him for permanent stay," the DFLP spokesman said.
He said that Palestinian President Yasser Arafat was working to facilitate the return of Hawatmeh -- currently based in Damascus -- but he had not yet been successful.
The DFLP was grouped within a 10-member alliance that vowed to wreck the Palestinain-Israeli peace deal which gave Palestinians self-rule over parts of the West Bank and Gaza Strip.
It pulled out of the alliance recently due to policy differences with other members over contacts with Arafat's Palestinian Authority.
